data.exact_reserve_text:
The result for Syndicate 1492 for the year ended 31 December 2019 is a profit of GBP 7,833,000 (2018: GBP 1,570,000), of which a loss of GBP 5,556,000 is attributable to the 2019 year of account, a profit of GBP 14,806,000 is attributable to the 2018 year of account and a loss of GBP 1,417,000 is attributable to the 2017 and prior years of account.
The 2017 & prior years of account is closing with a collectable loss of GBP 23,857,000 (2016 & prior years of account - GBP 10,447,000).

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2019 the syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding were GBP 95.568m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows a net prior-year gross adverse development of approximately GBP 10.9m (11.4% of opening gross reserves), driven predominantly by movements in the 2017 underwriting year partially offset by small releases on older years. The syndicate narrative also attributes prior-year results across years of account (2018 profit, 2017 & prior loss), and notes specific major loss items (e.g. Thomas Foods 2018) and that the 2017 & prior years are closing with a collectable loss. The Ogden rate change was stated to have negligible impact at year end. Reserves therefore show net gross strengthening by the triangle calculation, with named catastrophe events quantified modestly in the reserves note.
raw_causal_phrases: The calendar year has been benign with minimal major loss activity.
The reduction in the Ogden rate has not had any impact on Syndicate's 1492's reserves.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development derived from the gross claims development triangle (analysis of cumulative gross claims incurred) because no single note explicitly provided a gross "movement in prior year's provision" figure. The managing agent's year-of-account result breakdown (which is net/profit-focused) indicates a net release across prior years, which conflicts with the triangle-derived gross strengthening. Users should note this inconsistency: the triangle shows gross adverse development (~GBP 10.9m) while the YOA profit breakdown shows net prior-year improvement when net of reinsurance and other items. No RITC was identified to distort the triangle. Ogden change stated as having negligible impact.
